key_notes: Key 1 (t=2.34s): Initial archival pose of stop-sign; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.

why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of stop-sign (2.34s..5.94s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
